caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cradle with a rectangular frame supported by four corner posts and connected by spindles on all four sides. The wood is a medium to dark brown color with a polished appearance, showing rounded and turned details on both the posts and spindles. The cradle sits atop two curved wooden rockers that extend outward on each side. Inside the cradle, there is a rectangular mattress or cushion with a colorful geometric pattern consisting of repeating squares outlined in various colors such as red, blue, yellow, and green. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or elements present.
title: Doll's Cradle and Quilt
